purpose: Canonical replaceable-unit catalogue for spares, repair, ship construction and later frame integration.

geometry_rule.note: Dimensions are equipment replaceable-unit envelopes, not hull frames. Cobrett runtime geometry anchors are preserved; other sizes are scaled from declared mass/power using the same effective-density philosophy as ship_designer.py.

policy: A more powerful standard drive may replace a weaker unit and is software/power limited to the ship's rated thrust/input.
Large reactor ratings may be built from parallel banks of a smaller standard reactor; bank power is limited to the ship passport rating.
Standardization never changes the ship's rated thrust or required electrical input without an explicit later design decision.
Frame and mount geometry are deliberately not canonical yet; only equipment envelopes and service clearances are provided.

parts.name: LM-MP8 (лёгкий ракетный блок, 8 ракет)

missile.launch: outward (+Y), hot launch from the cell

parts.reload: end-loading hatch (+Z): canisters slide out on the cell rails; 8 rounds by a crew pair or a repair drone, ~20 min
parts.notes: Light external box launcher for small ships (Cobrett-I class). Sol Authority serial export item: regolith-grey walls on a rib grid, slate-blue frame, SMY rectangular rail mount with 4 twist pins (foreign hulls need an adapter rail). Per-cell frangible blow-out covers (mp8_hatch_N) and separate missiles (mp8_missile_N) so the model can show fired / empty cells. Mass basis: housing + rails ~0.6 t, 8 x 28 kg rounds.

basis: measured from the LOD1 model (tools/models/units/new_equipment.py)
geometry.frame: hull skin: mounting face y = 0, cells fire along +Y

parts.name: Hyperion RD-1 (разведывательный дрон)

sensor.turret: EO/IR camera + laser ranger on a 2-axis gimbal (yaw 360, pitch -90..+30)
sensor.comm: deployable dish on a carbon boom

parts.notes: Slender scout drone (~1.4 m): gold MLI foil over the body, carbon struts, white radome nose. Four field-coupled thruster rings (no propellant) on carbon outriggers, power block with a fin radiator under the belly. Docks by the Hyperion 3-point kinematic latch on its back; in an Agora std.bay.drone4 cradle (corner-casting standard) it needs a kinematic adapter plate. Envelope is with the antenna deployed; stowed (boom folded forward along the spine) the height drops to ~0.50 m.

basis: measured from the LOD1 model (tools/models/units/new_equipment.py)
geometry.frame: free flyer: long axis Z, nose +Z, docking latch +Y

parts.name: RM-2 «Мантис» (ремонтный дрон)
parts.walk: 4 legs with magnetic feet (hull walking, power-off hold)
parts.notes: Mantis-like repair drone: raptorial front arms (left = 2-jaw claw on a roll wrist, right = plasma cutter with gas/power cartridge), a fine-work tool arm under the head (driver bit, micro-gripper, work lamp), expressive sensor head with two eyes, three ocelli, lidar mandible and feelers; four walking legs on magnetic pads; abdomen = power pack with Agora corner castings for the std.bay.drone4 cradle twist locks (native fit). Field-coupled thruster pods on the thorax and abdomen fly it around obstacles. Patchwork palette (warm white / terracotta / sea blue) with brass joints. Every moving part is a separate OBJ part modelled in the rest pose; pivots in 'rig'. Stowed envelope assumes legs folded up along the body (femur +60, knee -80) and arms folded (elbow -110) - not modelled yet.

geometry.frame: walking on the hull: feet at y = 0, head +Z, +X = drone's left

rig.convention: OBJ frame, metres; every part is modelled in the rest pose (angle 0); rotate a part about axis through pivot_m (right-hand rule), children inherit the parent's transform; range_deg is a suggested animation range
